mission.name: Missing API Version
mission.description: helm install fails immediately with a parse error.
mission.objective: Add `apiVersion: v2` to Chart.yaml

mission.name: The First Deploy
mission.description: A simple nginx chart exists but `helm install` fails with "release name not valid".
mission.objective: Use a valid release name like `nginx-app`

mission.name: Image Not Found
mission.description: Chart installs but Pod goes into ImagePullBackOff.
mission.objective: Change tag to `latest`

mission.name: Not a Number
mission.description: helm install fails with "cannot unmarshal string into Go value of type int32".
mission.objective: Change to `replicaCount: 3` (no quotes)

mission.name: Required But Missing
mission.description: helm install fails with "required value missing: .Values.app.name".
mission.objective: Add `app:\n  name: my-app` to values.yaml

mission.name: Can't Reach It
mission.description: App deploys but isn't accessible. Service type is wrong.
mission.objective: Change to `ClusterIP`

mission.name: Wrong Door
mission.description: Service created but no endpoints. Port mismatch between service and container.
mission.objective: Change targetPort to 80

mission.name: Where Am I?
mission.description: `helm install` fails with "namespace not found".
mission.objective: Add `--create-namespace` flag or pre-create the namespace

mission.name: Already Taken
mission.description: Second `helm install` fails with "cannot re-use a name that is still in use".
mission.objective: Use `helm upgrade --install webapp` instead of `helm install webapp`

mission.name: Override Miss
mission.description: `helm upgrade --set` is used but the replica count doesn't change.
mission.objective: Change to `--set replicaCount=5` (camelCase)

mission.name: What's Actually Running?
mission.description: Player must identify a misconfigured value in the running release.
mission.objective: Use `helm upgrade` with corrected image.repository in values.yaml

mission.name: Wrong Version
mission.description: helm upgrade rejects chart because appVersion doesn't match running app.
mission.objective: Align appVersion in Chart.yaml or update image tag in values

mission.name: Inspect Before You Deploy
mission.description: Chart has wrong default resources. Player must identify via helm show.
mission.objective: Override with `-f custom-values.yaml` setting memory to 256Mi

mission.name: Test Before You Break
mission.description: Chart has a template error. Player must catch it before real install.
mission.objective: Use `helm install --dry-run` to catch the error, then add `default` function

mission.name: Lint It First
mission.description: Chart has multiple lint errors blocking install.
mission.objective: Add description, rename template file

mission.name: Quoted Numbers
mission.description: Deployment fails — replicas field receives a string.
mission.objective: Remove quotes OR add `| int` in template

mission.name: True or 'True'?
mission.description: Feature flag in values is `"true"` (string) but template uses `if .Values.feature.enabled` — always evaluates to truthy.
mission.objective: Change to `feature.enabled: false` (boolean)

mission.name: Nil Pointer Panic
mission.description: helm template crashes with nil pointer dereference.
mission.objective: Add `database:\n  host: localhost` to values.yaml OR use `{{ if .Values.database }}` guard

mission.name: Lost in the Tree
mission.description: Override is passed but has no effect — wrong nesting path.
mission.objective: Change --set to `--set database.host=db` (remove extra `config.` prefix)

mission.name: One or Many?
mission.description: Template expects a list for `ingress.hosts` but values has a single string.
mission.objective: Change to `ingress.hosts:\n  - "example.com"` (YAML list)

mission.name: Arrays in --set
mission.description: `--set` flag for an array value is malformed.
mission.objective: Use `--set ingress.hosts={host1.com,host2.com}` (curly braces for arrays)

mission.name: My Overrides Are Gone
mission.description: Player provides `-f custom.yaml` but the values don't appear to apply.
mission.objective: Fix indentation — values.yaml structure must match chart expectations

mission.name: Where's My Default?
mission.description: Template fails when optional value is unset — no `default` used.
mission.objective: Add `{{ .Values.optional.timeout | default 30 }}` in template

mission.name: YAML Indent Hell
mission.description: values.yaml fails to parse — mixed tabs and spaces.
mission.objective: Replace all tabs with spaces (2-space indent)

mission.name: Wrong Environment
mission.description: App deployed with production database URL in dev environment.
mission.objective: Create `values-dev.yaml` overriding database.url, apply with `-f values-dev.yaml`

mission.name: Escape Artist
mission.description: Password value with special characters breaks YAML parsing.
mission.objective: Quote the value: `db.password: "p@ss!word#1"`

mission.name: Mega vs Mebi
mission.description: Memory limit set to `256` (bytes) instead of `256Mi`.
mission.objective: Change to `resources.limits.memory: 256Mi`

mission.name: Registry Not Found
mission.description: Pod fails with ImagePullBackOff — image registry prefix missing.
mission.objective: Add full registry path to image.repository

mission.name: Schema Says No
mission.description: helm install fails with JSON schema validation error.
mission.objective: Set replicaCount to at least 1

mission.name: Force a String
mission.description: `--set version=1.0` passes an integer but template expects string for label.
mission.objective: Use `--set-string image.tag=1.0` to force string

mission.name: Unclosed Action
mission.description: helm template fails with "unclosed action".
mission.objective: Add missing `}` → `{{ .Values.app.name }}`

mission.name: toYaml Without Indent
mission.description: Deployment fails — resources block is not properly indented.
mission.objective: Change to `{{ .Values.resources | toYaml | indent 12 }}`

mission.name: The Missing Dot
mission.description: Template renders empty string where image name should be.
mission.objective: Correct to `{{ .Values.image.repository }}`

mission.name: Lost Context
mission.description: Template uses `.Release.Name` inside a `with` block — returns empty.
mission.objective: Use `{{ with .Values.config }}{{ $.Release.Name }}{{ end }}` (dollar sign for root)

mission.name: Function Not Found
mission.description: Template fails with "function 'uppercase' not defined".
mission.objective: Change to `{{ .Values.app.name | upper }}`

mission.name: Pipe Dream
mission.description: Template produces wrong output — pipe order incorrect.
mission.objective: Understand that empty string is falsy for `default` — use `| default "latest"` correctly OR use `required`

mission.name: Helper Not Found
mission.description: helm template fails with "no such template".
mission.objective: Either rename the helper or fix the include call to match

mission.name: Extra Blank Line
mission.description: Rendered YAML has unexpected blank line causing parse error.
mission.objective: Use `nindent` which adds newline before indenting, or remove the extra newline in helper

mission.name: Backwards Logic
mission.description: Service type is NodePort when it should be ClusterIP (and vice versa).
mission.objective: Swap the if/else: `{{ if .Values.ingress.enabled }}ClusterIP{{ else }}NodePort{{ end }}`

mission.name: Range Over Nothing
mission.description: helm template panics when env vars list is nil.
mission.objective: Add `extraEnv: []` to values.yaml as default, OR guard with `{{ if .Values.extraEnv }}`

mission.name: Who Am I?
mission.description: Template produces wrong output inside with block.
mission.objective: Use `{{ $.Values.app.name }}` (root context)

mission.name: Template in Template
mission.description: tpl function used incorrectly causes infinite recursion warning.
mission.objective: Fix the values.yaml message to be a valid template string

mission.name: You Must Provide This
mission.description: helm install blocks with unhelpful error from required.
mission.objective: Set `global.clusterName: my-cluster` in values.yaml

mission.name: Multiline Madness
mission.description: ConfigMap data has wrong multiline block syntax.
mission.objective: Use `|` block scalar or `{{ .Values.config | nindent 4 }}`

mission.name: Encode It
mission.description: Secret created but values are not base64 encoded — kubectl shows garbage.
mission.objective: Change to `password: {{ .Values.db.password | b64enc | quote }}`

mission.name: Call With Context
mission.description: Named template produces empty output — passed wrong context.
mission.objective: Change to `{{ include "myapp.fullname" . }}`

mission.name: Blank Line Invasion
mission.description: Rendered YAML has many blank lines making it hard to read and causing parse issues.
mission.objective: Add `-` to `{{-` and `-}}` consistently to trim whitespace

mission.name: Separate Your Resources
mission.description: Template file creates two resources but missing `---` separator.
mission.objective: Add `---` YAML document separator between resources

mission.name: Don't Repeat Yourself
mission.description: Labels are hardcoded in 3 templates instead of using a named helper — one was updated but not others.
mission.objective: Move labels to `_helpers.tpl`, use `{{ include "myapp.labels" . }}` in all templates

mission.name: Does It Exist?
mission.description: Chart blindly recreates Secret on each upgrade losing existing credentials.
mission.objective: Use `lookup` to check if Secret exists, preserve existing value if so

mission.name: The Failed State
mission.description: Previous install left release in `failed` state — new install rejected.
mission.objective: `helm uninstall <release>` then reinstall, OR fix the chart and `helm upgrade`

mission.name: Upgrade From Failure
mission.description: `helm upgrade` on a failed release — must use `--force` or fix first.
mission.objective: Fix the chart error (broken template), then helm upgrade

mission.name: Timed Out Waiting
mission.description: helm install with `--wait` times out — Pod never becomes Ready.
mission.objective: Fix readiness probe port in values.yaml

mission.name: Atomic or Nothing
mission.description: `helm upgrade --atomic` fails and auto-rolls back — player must diagnose original error.
mission.objective: Correct the image tag, upgrade again

mission.name: One Command Rules All
mission.description: CI pipeline fails on first deploy (no release exists) with plain `helm upgrade`.
mission.objective: Change to `helm upgrade --install myapp ./chart`

mission.name: Not My Resource
mission.description: helm install fails — resource already exists but not managed by this release.
mission.objective: Either delete the existing resource or adopt it with helm annotations

mission.name: You Can't Change That
mission.description: helm upgrade fails with "field is immutable".
mission.objective: `helm uninstall` then reinstall (or use `helm upgrade --force` to recreate)

mission.name: History Lesson
mission.description: App is broken — player must find which revision introduced the bug.
mission.objective: Use `helm history`, `helm get values --revision N`, identify bad revision

mission.name: Left Behind
mission.description: After helm uninstall, some resources remain (they were created outside Helm).
mission.objective: Delete orphaned resource, then helm install

mission.name: Gone But Not Forgotten
mission.description: Release uninstalled — player must restore it from history.
mission.objective: `helm rollback <release> <revision>` to restore from kept history

mission.name: Dry Run vs Template
mission.description: `helm template` works but `helm install --dry-run` fails — understand the difference.
mission.objective: Use `--dry-run` for cluster-aware checks

mission.name: Stuck Pending
mission.description: Release stuck in `pending-install` state — process was killed mid-install.
mission.objective: `helm uninstall <release>` to clear state (even for pending)

mission.name: CRD First
mission.description: Chart installs CRD and CR in same release — CR fails because CRD not ready yet.
mission.objective: Move CRD to crds/ directory (installed before templates)

mission.name: Test Your Release
mission.description: `helm test` fails — test pod has wrong command.
mission.objective: Fix the service name in the test template

mission.name: Post-Install Instructions
mission.description: NOTES.txt has a template error — install succeeds but notes crash.
mission.objective: Remove or fix the bad reference

mission.name: One Step Back
mission.description: Bad upgrade broke the app — perform a simple rollback.
mission.objective: `helm rollback <release> 1`

mission.name: Values Travel Back Too
mission.description: Player expects rollback to restore previous values — confirm this behavior.
mission.objective: Rollback restores replicaCount to 3

mission.name: Time Machine
mission.description: Multiple upgrades; player must roll back 3 versions to find working state.
mission.objective: `helm rollback <release> 1`

mission.name: Can't Rollback That
mission.description: Rollback fails because a manually deleted resource can't be restored.
mission.objective: Recreate the ConfigMap manually, then retry rollback

mission.name: Wait For It
mission.description: Rollback completes but app not healthy — need --wait flag.
mission.objective: Use `helm rollback --wait <release> <revision>`

mission.name: History Is Full
mission.description: helm history only shows 10 entries — older revisions gone.
mission.objective: Configure --history-max larger, or accept limitation and fix forward

mission.name: Force It Through
mission.description: Upgrade blocked by immutable field — use --force to recreate resources.
mission.objective: `helm upgrade --force` (deletes and recreates)

mission.name: Clean Slate
mission.description: Repeated failed installs left many `failed` revisions; chart fundamentally broken.
mission.objective: Fix the template, helm upgrade to create successful revision

mission.name: The Long Road Back
mission.description: 8 revisions; player must trace which revision introduced a memory leak (wrong limit).
mission.objective: Find the revision using `helm get values --revision N`, rollback

mission.name: Hooks on Rollback
mission.description: post-rollback hook fails — migration script not idempotent.
mission.objective: Make hook idempotent (IF NOT EXISTS pattern)

mission.name: Missing Revisions
mission.description: helm history shows gaps (1, 2, 5) — player confused about what happened.
mission.objective: Understand gaps are from failed/cleaned revisions; rollback to 2

mission.name: Persistent Volume Problem
mission.description: Rollback succeeds but StatefulSet PVC binding prevents pod from starting.
mission.objective: Understand PVC immutability; restore data manually if needed

mission.name: Config Restored
mission.description: Wrong nginx config deployed — rollback should restore working config.
mission.objective: `helm rollback` restores previous ConfigMap

mission.name: Switch Lanes
mission.description: Blue/green deployment via Helm — bad green deploy, switch back to blue.
mission.objective: Helm upgrade to switch Service selector back to blue

mission.name: Production Is Down
mission.description: Full production incident simulation — identify broken revision, rollback, verify recovery.
mission.objective: Helm history analysis, targeted rollback of specific subchart

mission.name: Lock It Down
mission.description: helm install fails — Chart.lock is missing.
mission.objective: Run `helm dependency update` to generate Chart.lock and download charts/

mission.name: Stale Dependencies
mission.description: Chart.yaml updated with new dependency version but Chart.lock not regenerated.
mission.objective: `helm dependency update` to sync lock with Chart.yaml

mission.name: Version Constraint
mission.description: Dependency version constraint doesn't match any available version.
mission.objective: Correct version to available range (e.g., `"~17.0.0"`)

mission.name: Name Collision
mission.description: Two dependencies with same name — one needs an alias.
mission.objective: Add `alias: postgresql-replica` to second dependency

mission.name: Pass It Down
mission.description: Subchart (postgresql) has wrong password — values not passed correctly.
mission.objective: Scope values under the subchart name: `postgresql:\n  auth:\n    password: mypass`

mission.name: Share With Everyone
mission.description: Multiple subcharts need same cluster name — must use global values.
mission.objective: Use `global.clusterName` — accessible in all subcharts via `.Values.global`

mission.name: Optional Component
mission.description: Redis subchart deploys even when caching is disabled.
mission.objective: Add `condition: redis.enabled` to dependency; `redis.enabled: false` in values

mission.name: Group Deploy
mission.description: Player wants to enable/disable a group of monitoring subcharts together.
mission.objective: Add `tags: [monitoring]` to each; use `tags.monitoring: false` in values

mission.name: Where's the Repo?
mission.description: `helm dependency update` fails — repository not added.
mission.objective: `helm repo add bitnami https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami`

mission.name: OCI Repository
mission.description: Dependency uses `oci://` protocol — requires different auth/syntax.
mission.objective: Correct OCI URL format, handle authentication

mission.name: Two Levels Deep
mission.description: Values override for a sub-subchart (dependency of a dependency) not reaching target.
mission.objective: Understand Helm value scoping; use global or restructure

mission.name: Local vs Remote
mission.description: Development using local chart in charts/ directory — path not resolving.
mission.objective: Correct relative path for local chart dependency

mission.name: Hooks in Subcharts
mission.description: Subchart has a pre-install hook that fails — blocks parent chart install.
mission.objective: Fix the hook script, or disable subchart hooks with --no-hooks

mission.name: Before We Begin
mission.description: pre-install hook Job fails — blocks entire release.
mission.objective: Fix DB host in hook Job spec

mission.name: Hook Timed Out
mission.description: post-install hook Job times out — Helm marks release failed.
mission.objective: Add `activeDeadlineSeconds: 60` to Job spec

mission.name: Clean Up After Yourself
mission.description: Hook Jobs accumulate after each upgrade — cluster fills up.
mission.objective: Add `"helm.sh/hook-delete-policy": "hook-succeeded"` annotation

mission.name: Order Matters
mission.description: Two pre-install hooks run in wrong order (schema migration before DB creation).
mission.objective: Set weights: DB creation hook weight -1, migration weight 0

mission.name: Migrate Before Upgrade
mission.description: App upgrade requires DB schema migration — it must run before new pods start.
mission.objective: Change hook type to pre-upgrade

mission.name: Leave No Trace
mission.description: Uninstalling the chart leaves orphaned PVCs — post-delete hook should clean them.
mission.objective: Add post-delete hook Job that deletes PVCs

mission.name: Old Hook Blocking
mission.description: Upgrade fails because old hook Job still exists (from previous run).
mission.objective: Manually delete the old hook Job, or change delete policy

mission.name: Test Your Work
mission.description: helm test fails — test pod checks wrong URL.
mission.objective: Fix URL path in test template

mission.name: Hook Needs Permission
mission.description: Hook Job fails with RBAC error — needs permission to list Pods.
mission.objective: Create ServiceAccount + Role + RoleBinding for hook, assign to Job

mission.name: Orchestra of Hooks
mission.description: 4 hooks (2 pre-install, 2 post-install) must run in specific order.
mission.objective: Assign weights -2, -1, 1, 2 to enforce correct order

mission.name: Secret's Not a Secret
mission.description: Plaintext password in values.yaml committed to git.
mission.objective: Remove from values.yaml; use `--set` for secrets or external-secrets

mission.name: Helm Needs RBAC
mission.description: Helm deploy fails — ServiceAccount lacks permission to create Deployments.
mission.objective: Create ClusterRole with required permissions, bind to ServiceAccount

mission.name: Block the Traffic
mission.description: Chart deploys NetworkPolicy but it blocks traffic it shouldn't.
mission.objective: Add ingress rule for health check probe source

mission.name: Run As Who?
mission.description: Pod fails to start — security context requires non-root but image runs as root.
mission.objective: Either change securityContext or use image that supports non-root

mission.name: Private Registry Auth
mission.description: Pod fails with ImagePullBackOff from private registry.
mission.objective: Create docker-registry Secret, set imagePullSecrets in values

mission.name: Lint Police
mission.description: Chart has 4 lint errors — fix all of them.
mission.objective: Fix all lint errors per helm lint output

mission.name: API Graveyard
mission.description: Chart uses `extensions/v1beta1` Deployment — removed in Kubernetes 1.16+.
mission.objective: Change to `apiVersion: apps/v1`, add required selector field

mission.name: Quota Exceeded
mission.description: Namespace has ResourceQuota — chart doesn't set requests, install rejected.
mission.objective: Add resources.requests.cpu and resources.requests.memory to values

mission.name: External Secret Store
mission.description: Chart should pull secrets from external-secrets operator, not bake them in.
mission.objective: Change to ExternalSecret resource referencing secret store

mission.name: Trust But Verify
mission.description: Unsigned chart from repository — must verify provenance.
mission.objective: Generate keypair, sign chart, verify with --verify flag

mission.name: Build the Foundation
mission.description: Repeated label blocks across 3 charts — extract to library chart.
mission.objective: Create library chart with shared helpers, add as dependency

mission.name: Stand on Shoulders
mission.description: Application chart uses library chart but include path wrong.
mission.objective: Correct the include name to match library's define

mission.name: Push and Pull
mission.description: Chart must be pushed to OCI registry and pulled back.
mission.objective: Correct OCI URL: `oci://registry.example.com/charts`

mission.name: Helmfile Harmony
mission.description: helmfile.yaml deploys 3 releases — one has wrong values file path.
mission.objective: Correct the path in helmfile.yaml

mission.name: Extend Helm
mission.description: CI script uses `helm diff` plugin but it's not installed.
mission.objective: `helm plugin install https://github.com/databus23/helm-diff`

mission.name: After the Render
mission.description: Chart needs kustomize patches applied after Helm render.
mission.objective: Create kustomization.yaml with required patches

mission.name: Your Own Repository
mission.description: ChartMuseum is running but helm push fails — auth wrong.
mission.objective: Add credentials to push command

mission.name: Kustomize Meets Helm
mission.description: Kustomize inflates Helm chart but values file path wrong.
mission.objective: Correct path, ensure kustomize can locate values

mission.name: GitOps Helm
mission.description: ArgoCD Application using Helm — custom values not applying.
mission.objective: Correct path to values file relative to chart root in git

mission.name: The Big Picture
mission.description: Umbrella chart orchestrating 5 microservices — one subchart fails and blocks all.
mission.objective: Fix subchart template error; understand umbrella chart failure modes

mission.name: Full Stack Down
mission.description: 3-tier app (frontend/backend/database) fails on install. Database hook fails, backend CrashLoops, frontend has wrong backend URL.
mission.objective: Fix in dependency order: database hook → backend env → frontend config

mission.name: Blue Green Deploy
mission.description: Implement blue/green deployment with Helm using two releases and Service selector switch.
mission.objective: Helm upgrade to switch Service selector to green

mission.name: Canary in the Coalmine
mission.description: Canary deployment where 10% traffic should go to new version — weight wrong.
mission.objective: Adjust replica counts to achieve ~10% canary split

mission.name: Crossing the Aisle
mission.description: Service in namespace A needs to call Service in namespace B — DNS not working.
mission.objective: Change to `backend-svc.namespace-b.svc.cluster.local` via chart values

mission.name: Wrong Image in Production
mission.description: Prod incident — wrong image tag deployed. Production environment has wrong values override.
mission.objective: Emergency upgrade with correct tag from production values file

mission.name: Out of Resources
mission.description: Bad limits causing node resource exhaustion — other pods evicted.
mission.objective: Add appropriate resource limits to chart, upgrade all affected releases

mission.name: Pipeline Breakdown
mission.description: Helmfile pipeline promotes dev→staging→prod — staging values file missing.
mission.objective: Add staging environment to helmfile.yaml with correct values

mission.name: CI/CD Upgrade Crisis
mission.description: CI/CD Helm upgrade script fails at step 3 of 5 — remaining steps skipped.
mission.objective: Add proper error handling and rollback logic to upgrade script

mission.name: Keep Your Repo Clean
mission.description: Chart repository has stale/corrupted index — helm repo update fails.
mission.objective: Regenerate index.yaml with `helm repo index`; push to repository

mission.name: Zero-to-Hero Incident Response
mission.description: Final mission. Complete production incident: 4 services down, bad Helm upgrade, wrong values across 3 environments, stuck hooks, and a dependency version conflict.
mission.objective: Systematic diagnosis and fix of all issues
